, false)
        return s
    end
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        if activeSlider then activeSlider.At(input.Position.X) end
        if PK.drag then pickAt(input.Position) end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if not isPress(input) then return end
        if activeSlider then
            TweenService:Create(activeSlider.Knob, TweenInfo.new(0.15), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16) }):Play()
            activeSlider = nil
            Content.ScrollingEnabled = true
        end
        PK.drag = nil
    end)

    -- muestra de color tocable (abre el selector)
    local function swatchRow(parent, order, es, en, getColor, setColor, defaultEs, defaultEn)
        local row = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        label(row, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -150, 1, 0), ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        local sw = mk("TextButton", { Parent = row, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, -78, 0.5, 0), Text = "", ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        corner(sw, 8)
        mk("UIStroke", { Parent = sw, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.4 })
        local reset = button(row, defaultEs, defaultEn, "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), TextSize = 10 })
        local api = {}
        function api.Refresh()
            local c = getColor()
            sw.BackgroundColor3 = c or Theme.Accent
            reset.BackgroundTransparency = c and 0.2 or 0.75
        end
        sw.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local before = getColor()
            openPicker(es, en, before or Theme.Accent, function(c)
                setColor(c)
                api.Refresh()
                changed()
            end, function(c)
                setColor(c)
                api.Refresh()
                changed()
            end, function()
                setColor(before)
                api.Refresh()
                changed()
            end)
        end)
        reset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            setColor(nil)
            api.Refresh()
            changed()
        end)
        api.Row = row
        return api
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 3) BOTÓN BASE
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "BOTÓN BASE", "BASE BUTTON", 4, "El círculo de atrás y su borde", "The circle behind and its border")
    local BaseCard = card(Content, 5)
    pad(BaseCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(BaseCard, 8)
    local baseChips = chips(BaseCard, { { "circle", "Con círculo", "With circle" }, { "none", "Solo imagen", "Image only" } }, 1, function(k)
        ED.rec.NoBackground = k == "none"
        refreshBaseCard()
        changed()
    end)
    local bgSwatch = swatchRow(BaseCard, 2, "Color del círculo", "Circle color", function() return ED.rec.BgColor end, function(c) ED.rec.BgColor = c end, "Del tema", "Theme")
    local borderSwatch = swatchRow(BaseCard, 3, "Color del borde", "Border color", function() return ED.rec.BorderColor end, function(c) ED.rec.BorderColor = c end, "Del tema", "Theme")
    refreshBaseCard = function()
        baseChips.Set(ED.rec.NoBackground and "none" or "circle")
        bgSwatch.Row.Visible = not ED.rec.NoBackground
        borderSwatch.Row.Visible = not ED.rec.NoBackground
        bgSwatch.Refresh()
        borderSwatch.Refresh()
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 4) CAPAS
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "CAPAS", "LAYERS", 6, "Hasta 3 imágenes, cada una con su propio movimiento · la 1 queda atrás", "Up to 3 images, each with its own movement · layer 1 is at the back")
    local LayersHolder = mk("Frame", { Parent = Content, Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 0), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 7, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
    list(LayersHolder, 10)
    local imageToken = {}

    -- revisa si la imagen carga (ContentProvider) y lo muestra en la píldora de la capa
    local function checkImage(index, url, pill)
        imageToken[index] = (imageToken[index] or 0) + 1
        local my = imageToken[index]
        local function show(es, en, color)
            if imageToken[index] ~= my or not pill.Parent then return end
            L(pill, es, en)
            pill.BackgroundColor3 = color
        end
        if url == "" then
            show("Sin imagen", "No image", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130))
            return
        end
        show("Cargando...", "Loading...", Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 40))
        task.spawn(function()
            local result = nil
            pcall(function()
                ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({ url }, function(_, status)
                    result = status
                end)
            end)
            if result == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
                show("Lista", "Ready", Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 90))
            elseif result == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Failure then
                show("No carga", "Not loading", Color3.fromRGB(205, 60, 70))
            else
                show("Sin respuesta", "No answer", Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130))
            end
        end)
    end

    local function layerCard(index)
        local lay = ED.rec.Layers[index]
        local c = card(LayersHolder, index)
        pad(c, 10, 10, 10, 10)
        list(c, 8)

        -- cabecera: número + estado de la imagen + quitar
        local head = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
        local num = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = head, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, Text = tostring(index), TextColor3 = Theme.AccentText, TextSize = 12, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        num:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")
        num:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "AccentText")
        num:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(num, 999)
        label(head, "Capa " .. index, "Layer " .. index, 12, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "Text", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(70, 24), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(32, 0), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        local pill = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = head, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 3), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 130), TextColor3 = WHITE, TextSize = 9, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        pill:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        corner(pill, 999)
        pad(pill, 0, 8, 8, 0)
        if #ED.rec.Layers > 1 then
            local del = button(head, "Quitar", "Remove", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(66, 24), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), TextSize = 10 })
            del.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                table.remove(ED.rec.Layers, index)
                rebuildLayerCards()
                changed()
            end)
        end

        -- imagen: miniatura + ID + botón de miniatura (rbxthumb) por si el ID es de un decal
        local imgRow = mk("Frame", { Parent = c, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
        local thumbBox = mk("Frame", { Parent = imgRow, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(48, 48), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 236), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        corner(thumbBox, 10)
        local thumb = mk("ImageLabel", { Parent = thumbBox, Size = UDim2.new(1, -6, 1, -6), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(3, 3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = CL.CleanAsset(lay.Image), ImageColor3 = lay.Color or WHITE, ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit, ZIndex = Z + 5 })
        local idBox = mk("TextBox", {
            Parent = imgRow,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -140, 0, 32),
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 56, 0.5, -16),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = lay.Image or "",
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            Font = Enum.Font.Code,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = Z + 4,
        })
        idBox:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        idBox:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        idBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "ID de la imagen")
        idBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Image ID")
        idBox.PlaceholderText = GetText("ID de la imagen", "Image ID")
        corner(idBox, 9)
        pad(idBox, 0, 10, 10, 0)
        local thumbBtn = button(imgRow, "Miniatura", "Thumbnail", "Background", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 32), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0), TextSize = 10 })
        local function applyImage(raw)
            lay.Image = CL.CleanAsset(raw)
            idBox.Text = lay.Image
            thumb.Image = lay.Image
            checkImage(index, lay.Image, pill)
            changed()
        end
        idBox.FocusLost:Connect(function() applyImage(idBox.Text) end)
        thumbBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local id = tostring(lay.Image or ""):match("(%d+)")
            if not id then
                setStatus("Primero poné un ID en la capa " .. index, "Put an ID in layer " .. index .. " first", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
                return
            end
            -- miniatura del asset: suele funcionar cuando pegaste el ID de un decal en vez del de la imagen
            applyImage("rbxthumb://type=Asset&id=" .. id .. "&w=420&h=420")
            setStatus("Capa " .. index .. ": ahora usa la miniatura del asset", "Layer " .. index .. ": now uses the asset thumbnail", Theme.Accent)
        end)
        checkImage(index, CL.CleanAsset(lay.Image), pill)

        -- movimiento
        local moveOpts = {}
        for _, m in ipairs(MOVES) do moveOpts[#moveOpts + 1] = { m[1], m[2], m[3] } end
        local speedS, amountS, dirChips, styleChips
        local function refreshMovement()
            local info = MOVE_INFO[lay.Movement] or {}
            speedS.Holder.Visible = info.speed ~= nil
            amountS.Holder.Visible = info.amount ~= nil
            dirChips.Row.Visible = info.dir == true
            styleChips.Row.Visible = info.style == true
            if info.speed then speedS.Configure(info.speed, info.speed[6], info.speed[7], lay.Speed) end
            if info.amount then amountS.Configure(info.amount, info.amount[6], info.amount[7], lay.Amount ~= 0 and lay.Amount or info.amount[4]) end
            dirChips.Set(lay.Direction == -1 and -1 or 1)
            styleChips.Set(lay.Style == "Constant" and "Constant" or "Organic")
        end
        local moveChips = chips(c, moveOpts, 3, function(key)
            lay.Movement = key
            local info = MOVE_INFO[key] or {}
            -- al cambiar de movimiento, valores por defecto con sentido para ese movimiento
            if info.speed then lay.Speed = info.speed[4] end
            lay.Amount = info.amount and info.amount[4] or 0
            refreshMovement()
            changed()
        end)
        moveChips.Set(lay.Movement)
        speedS = slider(c, 4, "Velocidad", "Speed", { 10, 600, 5, 60, "" }, lay.Speed, function(v) lay.Speed = v changed() end)
        amountS = slider(c, 5, "Intensidad", "Amount", { 0, 10, 1, 0, "" }, lay.Amount, function(v) lay.Amount = v changed() end)
        dirChips = chips(c, { { 1, "Horario", "Clockwise" }, { -1, "Antihorario", "Counter-clockwise" } }, 6, function(k) lay.Direction = k changed() end, 26)
        styleChips = chips(c, { { "Organic", "Orgánico (acelera y frena)", "Organic (speeds up & slows)" }, { "Constant", "Constante", "Constant" } }, 7, function(k) lay.Style = k changed() end, 26)
        slider(c, 8, "Tamaño", "Size", { 0.4, 4, 0.05, 1.6, "x" }, lay.Scale, function(v) lay.Scale = v changed() end)
        slider(c, 9, "Transparencia", "Transparency", { 0, 0.9, 0.05, 0, "" }, lay.Transparency or 0, function(v) lay.Transparency = v changed() end)
        local tint = swatchRow(c, 10, "Teñir la imagen", "Tint the image", function() return lay.Color end, function(col)
            lay.Color = col
            thumb.ImageColor3 = col or WHITE
        end, "Original", "Original")
        tint.Refresh()
        refreshMovement()
        return c
    end

    local AddLayerBtn = button(Content, "+  Agregar capa", "+  Add layer", "Secondary", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -4, 0, 38), LayoutOrder = 8, TextSize = 12 })
    AddLayerBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if #ED.rec.Layers >= 3 then return end
        table.insert(ED.rec.Layers, blankLayer(""))
        rebuildLayerCards()
        changed()
        task.defer(function()
            Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, math.max(0, AddLayerBtn.AbsolutePosition.Y - Content.AbsolutePosition.Y + Content.CanvasPosition.Y - 260))
        end)
    end)
    rebuildLayerCards = function()
        activeSlider = nil
        for _, ch in ipairs(LayersHolder:GetChildren()) do
            if ch:IsA("Frame") then ch:Destroy() end
        end
        for i = 1, #ED.rec.Layers do
            layerCard(i)
        end
        AddLayerBtn.Visible = #ED.rec.Layers < 3
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 5) SONIDOS
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "SONIDOS (OPCIONAL)", "SOUNDS (OPTIONAL)", 9, "Al tocar el botón y uno de fondo mientras flota", "On tap, plus an ambient one while it floats")
    local SoundCard = card(Content, 10)
    pad(SoundCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(SoundCard, 8)
    local function soundInput(order, es, en, getId, setId, getVol)
        local row = mk("Frame", { Parent = SoundCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 52), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = order, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
        label(row, es, en, 11, Enum.Font.GothamBold, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16), ZIndex = Z + 4 })
        local box = mk("TextBox", {
            Parent = row,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -84, 0, 30),
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 20),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
            BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Text = "",
            PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            Font = Enum.Font.Code,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = Z + 4,
        })
        box:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
        box:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
        box:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "ID del sonido (vacío = el de siempre)")
        box:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Sound ID (empty = default)")
        box.PlaceholderText = GetText("ID del sonido (vacío = el de siempre)", "Sound ID (empty = default)")
        corner(box, 9)
        pad(box, 0, 10, 10, 0)
        local test = button(row, "Probar", "Test", "Accent", { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(76, 30), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20), TextSize = 11 })
        box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
            setId(CL.CleanAsset(box.Text))
            box.Text = getId()
        end)
        test.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local id = CL.CleanAsset(box.Text)
            if id == "" then
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
            else
                playSound(id, getVol())
            end
        end)
        return box
    end
    local clickBox = soundInput(1, "Sonido al tocar", "Tap sound", function() return ED.rec.ClickSound.Id end, function(v) ED.rec.ClickSound.Id = v end, function() return ED.rec.ClickSound.Volume end)
    local clickVol = slider(SoundCard, 2, "Volumen al tocar", "Tap volume", { 0, 1, 0.05, 0.6, "" }, 0.6, function(v) ED.rec.ClickSound.Volume = v end)
    local idleBox = soundInput(3, "Sonido de fondo (con la ventana cerrada)", "Ambient sound (window closed)", function() return ED.rec.IdleSound.Id end, function(v) ED.rec.IdleSound.Id = v end, function() return ED.rec.IdleSound.Volume end)
    local idleEvery = slider(SoundCard, 4, "Cada cuántos segundos", "Every how many seconds", { 3, 120, 1, 15, "s" }, 15, function(v) ED.rec.IdleSound.Interval = v end)
    local idleVol = slider(SoundCard, 5, "Volumen de fondo", "Ambient volume", { 0, 1, 0.05, 0.15, "" }, 0.15, function(v) ED.rec.IdleSound.Volume = v end)
    refreshSoundCard = function()
        clickBox.Text = ED.rec.ClickSound.Id or ""
        clickVol.Set(ED.rec.ClickSound.Volume or 0.6, false)
        idleBox.Text = ED.rec.IdleSound.Id or ""
        idleEvery.Set(ED.rec.IdleSound.Interval or 15, false)
        idleVol.Set(ED.rec.IdleSound.Volume or 0.15, false)
    end

    -- =====================================================================
    -- 6) COMPARTIR
    -- =====================================================================
    sectionTitle(Content, "COMPARTIR", "SHARE", 11, "Pasale el código a un amigo y él lo pega acá", "Send the code to a friend and they paste it here")
    local ShareCard = card(Content, 12)
    pad(ShareCard, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    list(ShareCard, 8)
    local CodeBox = mk("TextBox", {
        Parent = ShareCard,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "",
        PlaceholderColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.Code,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        ZIndex = Z + 4,
    })
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderSpanish", "Pegá acá un código YYLOGO1:...")
    CodeBox:SetAttribute("PlaceholderEnglish", "Paste a YYLOGO1:... code here")
    CodeBox.PlaceholderText = GetText("Pegá acá un código YYLOGO1:...", "Paste a YYLOGO1:... code here")
    corner(CodeBox, 9)
    pad(CodeBox, 0, 10, 10, 0)
    local shareRow = mk("Frame", { Parent = ShareCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 2, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    local CopyBtn = button(shareRow, "Copiar código", "Copy code", "Accent", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0), TextSize = 11 })
    local ImportBtn = button(shareRow, "Cargar código", "Load code", "Secondary", { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -4, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 4, 0, 0), TextSize = 11 })
    CopyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local saved = recToSaved(ED.rec, "share")
        if not saved then
            setStatus("Agregá al menos una imagen antes de copiar", "Add at least one image before copying", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            return
        end
        local code = CL.Export(saved)
        CodeBox.Text = code
        if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
            pcall(setclipboard, code)
            setStatus("Código copiado: pegalo en un chat para compartirlo", "Code copied: paste it in a chat to share it", Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120))
        else
            setStatus("Tu ejecutor no copia al portapapeles: el código quedó en el cuadro", "Your executor can't copy: the code is in the box", Theme.Accent)
        end
    end)
    ImportBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local rec = CL.Import(CodeBox.Text)
        if not rec then
            setStatus("Ese código no es válido (tiene que empezar con YYLOGO1:)", "That code isn't valid (it must start with YYLOGO1:)", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            return
        end
        loadRecIntoEditor(recFromIcon(CL.ToIcon(rec), rec.Name), false)
        setStatus("Logo \"" .. rec.Name .. "\" cargado: tocá Crear logo para guardarlo", "Logo \"" .. rec.Name .. "\" loaded: tap Create logo to save it", Color3.fromRGB(80, 200, 120))
    end)

    -- =====================================================================
    -- ABRIR / CERRAR / GUARDAR
    -- =====================================================================
    local function stopLoop()
        if LS.loop then LS.loop:Disconnect() LS.loop = nil end
    end
    local function closeEditor()
        stopLoop()
        activeSlider = nil
        if LS.realLive then setRealLive(false) end
        setGhost(false)
        TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In), { Scale = 0.94 }):Play()
        task.delay(0.15, function() Overlay.Visible = false end)
    end

    openEditor = function(id)
        ED.editingId = id
        local saved = id and CL.Logos[id]
        if saved then
            ED.rec = recFromIcon(CL.ToIcon(saved), saved.Name)
        else
            ED.rec = blankRec()
        end
        NameBox.Text = ED.rec.Name
        L(Title, saved and "Editar logo" or "Estudio de Logos", saved and "Edit logo" or "Logo Studio")
        L(SaveBtn, saved and "Guardar cambios" or "Crear logo", saved and "Save changes" or "Create logo")
        L(Status, "", "")
        rebuildLayerCards()
        refreshBaseCard()
        refreshSoundCard()
        setBackdrop(LS.backdrop)
        backdropChips.Set(LS.backdrop)
        zoomChips.Set(LS.zoom)
        applyZoom()
        Hint.Visible, Hint.TextTransparency, Hint.BackgroundTransparency = true, 0, 0.45
        Ghost.Visible, ghostOpen, Ghost.GroupTransparency = false, false, 1
        PvButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 52)
        Content.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, 0)
        rebuildPreview()
        Overlay.Visible = true
        PanelScale.Scale = 0.94
        TweenService:Create(PanelScale, TweenInfo.new(0.28, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
        stopLoop()
        -- la vista previa se anima solo mientras el editor está abierto
        LS.loop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            stepLayers(LS.live, dt)
        end)
    end

    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeEditor)
    CancelBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(closeEditor)
    SaveBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        ED.rec.Name = NameBox.Text:sub(1, 24)
        if ED.rec.Name:match("^%s*$") then
            setStatus("Ponele un nombre a tu logo", "Give your logo a name", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            NameBox:CaptureFocus()
            return
        end
        local saved = recToSaved(ED.rec, ED.editingId or CL.NewId())
        if not saved then
            setStatus("Falta la imagen: pegá un ID en la capa 1", "Missing image: paste an ID in layer 1", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            return
        end
        local okSave, err = CL.Put(saved)
        if err == "max" then
            setStatus("Llegaste al máximo de " .. CL.Max .. " logos: borrá uno primero", "You reached the max of " .. CL.Max .. " logos: delete one first", Color3.fromRGB(235, 90, 90))
            return
        end
        playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
        local key = CL.Key(saved.Id)
        SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon = key
        SaveConfig()
        if LS.realLive then
            setRealLive(false) -- vuelve a dibujar SavedConfig.SelectedLogoIcon (el nuevo)
        else
            ApplyLogoIcon(key)
        end
        LS.RefreshCards()
        for _, other in ipairs(LP.cards) do
            LP.paint(other, other.key == key, true)
        end
        LP.setHero(key)
        closeEditor()
        if not okSave then
            warn("[YinYang Logos] Tu ejecutor no tiene writefile: el logo dura hasta que cierres el juego")
        end
    end)

    -- =====================================================================
    -- PREMIUM (gamepass "Yin Yang Studio Logos"): crear / editar logos
    -- =====================================================================
    -- El gamepass queda en la CUENTA de Roblox: se consulta a Roblox cada vez que carga el script
    -- (cualquier dispositivo, cualquier ejecutor). El archivo local solo se usa si Roblox no responde.
    local MPS = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
    local PR = { owned = false, checking = true, listeners = {}, price = nil }
    local PASS_ID = PremiumConfig.GamepassId
    local PASS_URL = "https://www.roblox.com/game-pass/" .. tostring(PASS_ID)

    local function readCache()
        local ok, data = pcall(function()
            if isfile and readfile and isfile(PremiumConfig.CacheFile) then
                return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(PremiumConfig.CacheFile))
            end
            return nil
        end)
        return ok and type(data) == "table" and data.UserId == LocalPlayer.UserId and data.Pass == PASS_ID and data.Owned == true
    end
    local function writeCache(owned)
        pcall(function()
            if writefile then
                writefile(PremiumConfig.CacheFile, HttpService:JSONEncode({ UserId = LocalPlayer.UserId, Pass = PASS_ID, Owned = owned == true, At = os.time() }))
            end
        end)
    end
    function PR.set(owned, fromApi)
        PR.owned = owned == true
        PR.checking = false
        if fromApi then writeCache(PR.owned) end
        for _, fn in ipairs(PR.listeners) do pcall(fn, PR.owned) end
    end
    local function isOwnerName()
        local me = string.lower(LocalPlayer.Name)
        for _, n in ipairs(PremiumConfig.Owners or {}) do
            if string.lower(tostring(n)) == me then return true end
        end
        return false
    end
    function PR.check()
        PR.checking = true
        for _, fn in ipairs(PR.listeners) do pcall(fn, PR.owned) end
        task.spawn(function()
            if isOwnerName() then PR.set(true, false) return end
            local okOwn, owns = false, nil
            for attempt = 1, 3 do
                okOwn, owns = pcall(function()
                    return MPS:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId, PASS_ID)
                end)
                if okOwn then break end
                task.wait(attempt * 1.5)
            end
            -- el creador del pase siempre tiene acceso (aunque no se lo haya "comprado")
            local okInfo, info = pcall(function()
                return MPS:GetProductInfo(PASS_ID, Enum.InfoType.GamePass)
            end)
            if okInfo and type(info) == "table" then
                PR.price = tonumber(info.PriceInRobux)
                local creator = info.Creator
                if type(creator) == "table" and tonumber(creator.CreatorTargetId) == LocalPlayer.UserId then
                    owns, okOwn = true, true
                end
            end
            if okOwn then
                PR.set(owns == true, true)
            else
                -- Roblox no respondió: se usa la última verificación buena de esta cuenta
                PR.set(readCache(), false)
            end
        end)
    end
    -- compra terminada dentro del juego: se desbloquea al instante
    pcall(function()
        MPS.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
            if player == LocalPlayer and tonumber(passId) == PASS_ID and purchased then
                PR.set(true, true)
            end
        end)
    end)

    -- ---------- candado dibujado (arco + cuerpo) ----------
    local GOLD_A, GOLD_B = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 90), Color3.fromRGB(255, 140, 40)
    local function goldGradient(parent, rotation)
        return mk("UIGradient", { Parent = parent, Rotation = rotation or 45, Color = ColorSequence.new(GOLD_A, GOLD_B) })
    end
    local function drawLock(parent, px, z)
        local holder = mk("Frame", { Parent = parent, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(px, px), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z })
        local shackle = mk("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.56, 0.62), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.02), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z })
        corner(shackle, 999)
        local ss = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = shackle, Color = WHITE, Thickness = math.max(2, px * 0.1) })
        goldGradient(ss, 90)
        local body = mk("Frame", { Parent = holder, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.82, 0.56), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 1 })
        corner(body, math.max(3, math.floor(px * 0.14)))
        goldGradient(body, 90)
        local hole = mk("Frame", { Parent = body, Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.16, 0.36), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.48), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 34, 8), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 2 })
        corner(hole, 999)
        return holder
    end

    -- ---------- hoja "Premium" ----------
    local PSheet = mk("Frame", { Parent = Main, Name = "LogoPremiumOverlay", Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Visible = false, Active = true, ZIndex = Z })
    local PCard = mk("Frame", { Parent = PSheet, Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.92, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background, BorderSizePixel = 0, Active = true, ZIndex = Z + 1 })
    PCard:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Background")
    corner(PCard, 18)
    local PCardStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = PCard, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2 })

    PCardGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new({ ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, GOLD_A), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(255, 250, 220)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, GOLD_B) })
    TweenService:Create(PCardGrad, TweenInfo.new(4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), { Rotation = 360 }):Play()
    local PScale = mk("UIScale", { Parent = PCard, Scale = 1 })
    pad(PCard, 14, 16, 16, 14)

    -- encabezado: candado que flota + título + chip PREMIUM
    local PHead = mk("Frame", { Parent = PCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 64), BackgroundTransparency = 1, LayoutOrder = 1, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
    local PIcon = mk("Frame", { Parent = PHead, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 60), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 26, 8), BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
    corner(PIcon, 16)
    local PIconStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = PIcon, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5 })
    goldGradient(PIconStroke, 45)
    local PLock = drawLock(PIcon, 32, Z + 3)
    TweenService:Create(PLock, TweenInfo.new(1.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1, true), { Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, -3) }):Play()
    local PChip = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = PHead, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18), AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X, Position = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 2), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, Text = "PREMIUM", TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 34, 8), TextSize = 10, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    PChip:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
    corner(PChip, 999)
    pad(PChip, 0, 9, 9, 0)
    goldGradient(PChip, 0)
    label(PHead, "Yin Yang Studio Logos", "Yin Yang Studio Logos", 17, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, "Text", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 22), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 22), ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    label(PHead, "Creá tus propios botones flotantes", "Create your own floating buttons", 10, Enum.Font.GothamMedium, "TextDim", { Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 0, 14), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(72, 45), ZIndex = Z + 3 })
    local PClose = mk("TextButton", { Parent = PHead, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary, Text = "×", TextColor3 = Theme.Text, TextSize = 19, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, ZIndex = Z + 4 })
    PClose:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
    PClose:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
    corner(PClose, 999)
    RowKit.Control(PClose)

    -- cuerpo en dos columnas: demostración (cuadrado) + información y compra
    local PBody = mk("Frame", { Parent = PCard, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -74), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 74), BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
    local RightCol = mk("ScrollingFrame", {
        Parent = PBody,
        Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 6, 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ScrollBarThickness = 2,
        AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,

    list(RightCol, 8)

    -- =================== DEMOSTRACIÓN ANIMADA ===================
    -- Un mini estudio que se arma solo: ID -> imagen, movimiento, colores, guardar.
    -- Corre solo mientras la ventana premium está abierta (tweens nativos + una corrutina).
    -- Va en su propia función: BuildLogoStudio está cerca del límite de 200 locales de Luau.
    local startDemo, stopDemo = (function()
    local Demo = mk("Frame", { Parent = PBody, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -6, 1, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0.25, -3, 0.5, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = Z + 2 })
    mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { Parent = Demo, AspectRatio = 1 })
    corner(Demo, 14)
    vgrad(Demo, Color3.fromRGB(78, 150, 232), Color3.fromRGB(176, 220, 252))
    local DemoStroke = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = Demo, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.2 })
    goldGradient(DemoStroke, 45)
    local DZ = Z + 3
    local function dframe(props)
        props.Parent = props.Parent or Demo
        props.BorderSizePixel = 0
        props.ZIndex = props.ZIndex or DZ
        return mk("Frame", props)
    end
    local function dtext(parent, txt, size, color, props)
        local t = mk("TextLabel", { Parent = parent, BackgroundTransparency = 1, Text = txt, TextColor3 = color or WHITE, TextSize = size, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextScaled = false, ZIndex = DZ + 2 })
        t:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
        for k, v in pairs(props or {}) do t[k] = v end
        return t
    end
    -- paisaje
    for _, m in ipairs({ { 0.2, 0.7 }, { 0.62, 0.9 }, { 0.95, 0.6 } }) do
        dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(m[2] * 0.6, m[2] * 0.6), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(m[1], 0.74), Rotation = 45, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(96, 128, 170), ZIndex = DZ })
    end
    local dGround = dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.72), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = DZ + 1 })
    vgrad(dGround, Color3.fromRGB(112, 186, 104), Color3.fromRGB(58, 118, 62))

    -- mini panel del estudio (arriba): campo de ID + chips + colores + guardar
    local dPanel = dframe({ Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0.3, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.04), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24), BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, ZIndex = DZ + 2 })
    corner(dPanel, 10)
    local dId = dframe({ Parent = dPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0.36, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.08), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48), ZIndex = DZ + 3 })
    corner(dId, 6)
    local dIdText = dtext(dId, "ID: ", 9, Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240), { Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 1, 0), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 0), Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = DZ + 4 })
    local function dchip(txt, x)
        local c = dframe({ Parent = dPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0.24, 0, 0.34, 0), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, 0.56), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60), ZIndex = DZ + 3 })
        corner(c, 999)
        dtext(c, txt, 8, WHITE, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), ZIndex = DZ + 4 })
        return c
    end
    local chipSpin = dchip("Girar", 0.15)
    local swPink = dframe({ Parent = dPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.38, 0, 0.56, 0), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 170), ZIndex = DZ + 3 })
    corner(swPink, 999)
    local swGold = dframe({ Parent = dPanel, Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 14), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.56, 0), BackgroundColor3 = GOLD_A, ZIndex = DZ + 3 })
    corner(swGold, 999)
    local chipSave = dchip("Guardar", 0.8)
    chipSave.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD_B

    -- el botón que se va armando (misma composición que el real: círculo + capas a 1.6x)
    local dBtn = dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.26, 0.26), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70), ZIndex = DZ + 5 })
    mk("UIAspectRatioConstraint", { Parent = dBtn, AspectRatio = 1 })
    corner(dBtn, 999)
    mk("UIStroke", { Parent = dBtn, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.3 })
    local dBtnScale = mk("UIScale", { Parent = dBtn, Scale = 1 })
    local function dlayer(img, z)
        return mk("ImageLabel", { Parent = dBtn, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.6, 1.6), Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.3, -0.3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Image = img, ImageTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z })
    end
    -- imágenes del Yin Yang Clásico (catálogo oficial)
    local dBase = dlayer("rbxassetid://106130066496682", DZ + 6)
    local dRing = dlayer("rbxassetid://70721341917757", DZ + 7)

    -- texto del paso + cartel de guardado
    local dCaption = dtext(Demo, "", 10, WHITE, { Size = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0, 20), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -8), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.4, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, ZIndex = DZ + 8 })
    corner(dCaption, 999)
    local dToast = dtext(Demo, "", 11, Color3.fromRGB(50, 28, 6), { Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 22), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.42), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Visible = false, ZIndex = DZ + 9 })
    corner(dToast, 999)
    goldGradient(dToast, 0)
    local dToastScale = mk("UIScale", { Parent = dToast, Scale = 1 })

    -- dedo que toca (círculo blanco con onda)
    local dFinger = dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.9), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 0.15, ZIndex = DZ + 10 })
    corner(dFinger, 999)
    mk("UIStroke", { Parent = dFinger, Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Thickness = 1.5, Transparency = 0.5 })
    local dFingerScale = mk("UIScale", { Parent = dFinger, Scale = 1 })

    local demoGen = 0
    local ringTween = nil
    -- posición (en el cuadrado) del centro de un elemento del mini panel
    local function centerOf(el)
        if el.Parent == dPanel then
            local p = el.Position
            -- dPanel: x 0.04..0.96, y 0.04..0.34 del cuadrado
            return UDim2.new(0.04 + p.X.Scale * 0.92, 0, 0.04 + (p.Y.Scale + 0.17) * 0.3, 0)
        end
        return el.Position
    end
    local function demoReset()
        if ringTween then ringTween:Cancel() ringTween = nil end
        dIdText.Text = "ID: "
        dBase.ImageTransparency, dRing.ImageTransparency, dRing.Rotation = 1, 1, 0
        dRing.ImageColor3 = WHITE
        dBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
        dBtn.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.58)
        dBtnScale.Scale = 1
        chipSpin.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 60)
        dToast.Visible = false
        dCaption.Text = ""
    end
    local function runDemo(gen)
        local function alive() return demoGen == gen and PSheet.Visible end
        local function pause(t)
            task.wait(t)
            return alive()
        end
        local function tap(el)
            TweenService:Create(dFinger, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = centerOf(el) }):Play()
            if not pause(0.5) then return false end
            TweenService:Create(dFingerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.08), { Scale = 0.65 }):Play()
            -- onda del toque
            local ring = dframe({ Size = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 16), AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = dFinger.Position, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = DZ + 9 })
            corner(ring, 999)
            local rs = mk("UIStroke", { Parent = ring, Color = WHITE, Thickness = 2 })
            TweenService:Create(ring, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 40) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(rs, TweenInfo.new(0.4), { Transparency = 1 }):Play()
            task.delay(0.45, function() ring:Destroy() end)
            if not pause(0.1) then return false end
            TweenService:Create(dFingerScale, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            return pause(0.25)
        end
        local function caption(es, en)
            dCaption.Text = GetText(es, en)
        end
        while alive() do
            demoReset()
            if not pause(0.4) then break end
            -- 1) pegar el ID: aparece la imagen base
            caption("1 · Pegá el ID de tu imagen", "1 · Paste your image ID")
            if not tap(dId) then break end
            local id = "106130066496682"
            for i = 1, #id do
                dIdText.Text = "ID: " .. id:sub(1, i)
                if not pause(0.035) then break end
            end
            if not alive() then break end
            dBtnScale.Scale = 0.75
            TweenService:Create(dBase, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dBtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            -- 2) movimiento: el anillo aparece y gira
            caption("2 · Elegí un movimiento", "2 · Pick a movement")
            if not tap(chipSpin) then break end
            chipSpin.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD_B
            TweenService:Create(dRing, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageTransparency = 0 }):Play()
            ringTween = TweenService:Create(dRing, TweenInfo.new(2.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut, -1), { Rotation = 360 })
            ringTween:Play()
            if not pause(1) then break end
            -- 3) colores: círculo rosa, anillo dorado
            caption("3 · Cambiá los colores", "3 · Change the colors")
            if not tap(swPink) then break end
            TweenService:Create(dBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 170) }):Play()
            if not pause(0.3) then break end
            if not tap(swGold) then break end
            TweenService:Create(dRing, TweenInfo.new(0.35), { ImageColor3 = GOLD_A }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            -- 4) guardar: cartel + el logo vuela a la esquina como botón flotante
            caption("4 · Guardalo y ¡listo!", "4 · Save it and done!")
            if not tap(chipSave) then break end
            dToast.Text = GetText("Guardado", "Saved")
            dToast.Visible = true
            dToastScale.Scale = 0.6
            TweenService:Create(dToastScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Scale = 1 }):Play()
            if not pause(0.7) then break end
            dToast.Visible = false
            TweenService:Create(dBtn, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.13, 0.45) }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dBtnScale, TweenInfo.new(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), { Scale = 0.6 }):Play()
            TweenService:Create(dFinger, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), { Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.85, 0.9) }):Play()
            caption("Tu botón flotante, a tu gusto", "Your floating button, your way")
            if not pause(2.2) then break end
        end
    end
    local function startDemo()
        demoGen += 1
        task.spawn(runDemo, demoGen)
    end
    local function stopDemo()
        demoGen +=
